product.description: Monoprice™Cat6A Ethernet Patch Cable - Bendable, UTP, 28AWGDesigned for Modern Networks Requiring Speed and FlexibilityExperience uncompromising speed, flexibility, and reliability with this Cat6A Ethernet Patch Cable, engineered to meet the demands of modern high-performance networks. Designed for both professional and everyday environments, it combines advanced electrical performance with a sleek, ultra-slim form factor—making it an ideal solution for data centers, offices, smart homes, and gaming setups alike.Built to the Cat6A standard, this unshielded twisted pair (UTP) patch cable supports bandwidths up to 500MHz and delivers ultra-fast data transmission suitable for 10-Gigabit Ethernet applications. Whether you’re streaming high-definition content, managing large data transfers, or running latency-sensitive applications, it ensures consistent, low-interference performance across your network. Precision-twisted copper conductors are optimized to minimize crosstalk and signal loss, helping maintain stable connections even in dense networking environments.One standout feature of this cable is its ultra-slim 28AWG design. Compared to traditional, thicker Ethernet cables, the reduced diameter allows for improved airflow, easier routing, and cleaner cable management—especially in crowded racks, behind desks, or along walls. Despite its slim profile, the cable does not compromise on performance or reliability. It is carefully engineered to meet Cat6A specifications while offering superior flexibility and convenience.To further enhance usability and durability, the cable features a bendable molded boot that protects the RJ45 connector while allowing smooth bending and easy plug-in and removal—even in crowded patch panels and switches. This flexible design helps reduce strain at the connector, extending the cable’s overall lifespan. Built-in strain relief provides added protection, ensuring reliable performance in high-traffic or frequently reconfigured installations.Compatibility is broad and seamless. This Cat6A patch cable works effortlessly with a wide range of devices, including routers, switches, modems, patch panels, network interface cards, gaming consoles, PCs, printers, IP cameras, and VoIP phones. It is fully backward compatible with Cat6, Cat5e, and Cat5 networks, making it a versatile upgrade or replacement option for existing infrastructure.To accommodate diverse setup needs, the cable is available in multiple convenient length options (measured in feet), allowing you to choose the perfect fit for short connections or longer runs without excess slack. A variety of color options also makes cable organization simple and efficient, helping IT professionals and home users easily identify and manage multiple connections at a glance.Combining performance, flexibility, and modern aesthetics, this Cat6A Ethernet Patch Cable is a smart choice for anyone seeking a reliable, space-saving networking solution.
